assumptions: the controls are actual-scene variance controls of the same estimator
the chart is a local gnomonic chart and the query lies inside a support triangle
delta_i and the curvature bound M are external information, not fitted from the same sparse points
condition: actual scene, same estimator and response
estimand: log V at the query point and the variance interval [exp(u-Delta), exp(u+Delta)]
goal: Verify the sparse actual-scene variance reconstruction: with an external delta and a known curvature bound the truth must lie inside the reported interval, without a curvature bound only a conditional prediction is allowed, and no cross-leaf covariance may be manufactured.

independence.note: truth is produced before and independently of any observed run

negative_expectations.expectation: a smooth field that vanishes at every control point but is large at the query must not be certified by smoothness
without M only a conditional prediction is allowed
a query outside the support must not be filled by nearest neighbour

positive_expectations.expectation: the plane truth lies inside the interval
the quadratic truth lies inside the interval built with the known Hessian bound
the affine truth is reproduced exactly by the barycentric interpolation

tolerance.conditional_without_M: no interval may be published without M
tolerance.cross_leaf_covariance: no off-diagonal covariance may be produced
tolerance.interval_containment: the truth must lie inside the reported interval

unit: log of a variance (dimensionless); the variance is in the unit of the controls
